verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes are explicitly documented as ephemeral, isolated containers for running untrusted/agent code, with filesystem isolation, network controls (block_network, CIDR/domain allowlists), and snapshotting — all of which support safe testing separate from any production system, and community builders confirm using them for isolated agent/runner workloads. Missing for 10: explicit mention of connecting to or masking production datasets, and no independent third-party audit specifically validating data isolation from production systems.
